themes.name: Cloud infrastructure capital cycle

materiality.reason: Test whether reported infrastructure investment is large enough to affect issuer economics.

novelty.reason: The SEC collector does not measure whether the market has already priced the thesis.

breadth.reason: A licensed market cohort snapshot is required to measure breadth.

durability.reason: Multi-period filings can test persistence, but the narrative still needs filing-text review.

timeliness.reason: SEC acceptance timestamps receive an estimated availability offset and do not prove market timing.

transmission_chain: Utilization and product mix may affect issuer cash generation.
data_gaps: Licensed price, breadth, rates, and liquidity evidence must be supplied separately.

candidates.name: Microsoft Corporation
candidates.thesis: Cloud infrastructure demand may support durable platform economics, subject to filing-level verification.
candidates.bull_case: Reported revenue, operating income, and cash generation may confirm operating leverage.
candidates.bear_case: Capital intensity or slower workload conversion may offset demand growth.
candidates.risk_verdict: Do not advance the thesis until the filing text, current TTM bridge, and licensed market evidence are reviewed.
invalidation_conditions: Revenue and operating cash generation fail to support the infrastructure-demand hypothesis.
manual_review_items: Read the linked filing and verify every narrative statement against issuer disclosure.
